Zuckerman Investment Group Llc increased its stake in Comcast Corp. New (CMCSA) by 79.11% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Zuckerman Investment Group Llc bought 150,316 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 340,334 shares of the television services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $11.63 million, up from 190,018 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Zuckerman Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Comcast Corp. New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $143.85B market cap company. The stock increased 0.26% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $31.26. About 15.59 million shares traded. Comcast Corporation (NASDAQ:CMCSA) has declined 21.29% since June 3, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.86% the S&P500.
